method: Scheduled Pillar Two 30-day news refresh (20 Nov 2026 HKT): WebSearch plus fetching primary official pages for OECD, HK IRD/LegCo, SG IRAS/MOF/SSO, and JP NTA/MOF. Items added only when date and content were confirmed against a fetched source.

coverage.OECD: Checked 20 Nov 2026: The OECD GloBE publications HTML page fetched successfully. Latest Administrative Guidance remains September 2026; no November 2026 model rules, AG, GIR, Central Record or Full Legislative Review. Central Record official PDF re-fetched (HTTP Last-Modified still 15 May 2026; PDF current as at 1 May 2026); Qualified SbS Regimes still list only the United States from 1 January 2026. Catalogued items unchanged (plenary 30 Oct; GIR XML Schema v2.0 20 Oct; Romania STTR 2 Oct). A 19 Nov OECD announcement was opened and is BEPS Action 14 MAP peer reviews (not a standalone GloBE document). The 4 Nov Tax Certainty Day announcement remains 2025 MAP/APA statistics, not a GloBE document. Deloitte World Tax Advisor 20 Nov PDF, which returned 404 on 19 Nov, is now live and was opened: its OECD item is a tax-administration digitalization inventory, not GloBE, and it has no other in-scope Pillar Two item. No standalone OECD GloBE document published since the 30 Oct plenary statement.
coverage.HK: Checked 20 Nov 2026: IRD What's New and GMT/HKMTT page fetched. Newest What's New item remains the 17 Nov List of Debt Instruments and Sovereign Bonds Eligible for Profits Tax Concession or Exemption (as at 30 June 2026), not Pillar Two. No new IRD What's New Pillar Two item after the catalogued 26 Oct Portal BIR82 filing. The 5 Nov LC Paper No. CB(1)1388/2026(01) remains the latest official HK Pillar Two item; the planned subsidiary legislation has not yet been gazetted (planned negative vetting Dec 2026, commencement Feb 2027). Today is a Friday Gazette day and the e-Gazette site footer reads last revision date 20 November 2026, but IRD What's New, web search, and the LegCo subsidiary-legislation page show no GloBE/HKMTT legal notice or negative-vetting item; the e-Gazette search itself required a terms-acceptance wall and was not used. Opened Inland Revenue (Amendment) (Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework and Amended Common Reporting Standard) Ordinance 2026 (Ord. No. 8 of 2026) on prior runs: Schedule 61/62/64 edits are technical (s.2 cross-references and the 2025 Commentary/Examples), not the 2026 GloBE documents, and were not catalogued. PwC HK Tax News Flash still ends at Issue 19 (5 Nov); no public trace of Issue 20 was found (index and Issue 20 URL returned 403). Deloitte World Tax Advisor 20 Nov HK item is the already-known CARF/CRS bill passage, not Pillar Two. KPMG's November note remains secondary coverage of the already-catalogued 5 Nov LegCo paper.
coverage.SG: Checked 20 Nov 2026: IRAS Latest Updates fetched (newest item is 18 Nov GST: Guide on Exports, not Pillar Two; latest Pillar Two e-Tax Guide still 30 Oct Third Edition), IRAS GloBE/DTT page (last updated 13 Oct 2026), IRAS Newsroom (newest 17 Nov item is a GST refund-fraud conviction, not Pillar Two), MOF newsroom (newest 12 Nov item is the Budget 2027 consultation; page last updated 17 Nov 2026), and PwC Singapore Tax News (12 Nov entries are Budget 2027 consultation and FEDR; latest SG Pillar Two entries remain 4 Nov Act 23 and 30 Oct Third Edition) fetched. Finance (Income Taxes) Act 2026 remains Act 23. Later 2026 Acts 24–26 are Financial Services and Markets, Digital Infrastructure and Land Transport, not Pillar Two. Act 27 of 2026, published 17 Nov, was opened and is the Transboundary Haze Pollution (Amendment) Act 2026, not Pillar Two; no Act 28 was found. SSO Acts-Supplement and MMT Act subsidiary-legislation browse pages returned 403 or timed out from this environment; instrument-level checks and SL-Supplement search found no new 2026 MMT Regulations (current instruments remain S 1062/2024, S 1060/2024 and S 861/2025, plus earlier 2025 S 129 and S 178). Catalogued items unchanged.
coverage.JP: Checked 20 Nov 2026: NTA 新着情報 fetched through 18 Nov; no newer item on 19–20 Nov. Newest 18 Nov item remains 新設法人が設立の日に通算グループから離脱する場合のその法人の事業年度及び青色申告の承認について（文書回答事例）, a consolidation-group / blue-return ruling, not Pillar Two. No Pillar Two items after the catalogued 21 Oct GIR AEOI partner list. 17 Nov sake-safety measures; 13 Nov sake-export statistics; 11 Nov driver recruitment; 9 Nov student tax-essay awards; 2 Nov tobacco hand-held stock tax remain non-Pillar Two. GIR EOI hub still points to the October 2026 (令和8年10月) partner list; the official PDF was re-opened and is still current as at 1 October 2026. The 9 Oct 趣旨説明 remains catalogued but falls before the rolling 30-day window starting 21 Oct. NTA グローバル・ミニマム課税関係 page and MOF グローバル・ミニマム課税の概要 page (https://www.mof.go.jp/tax_policy/summary/international/337.html) fetched; no new JP IIR/QDMTT/GIR administrative guidance or November 2026 MOF Pillar Two publications.
